newsitem.title: USA: Unifi says 1.75 mln shrs tendered in auction.
newsitem.headline: Unifi says 1.75 mln shrs tendered in auction.

text.p: Unifi Inc said on Monday preliminary results indicated 1.75 million shares, or 2.7 percent of the company's outstanding stock, were tendered in its Dutch auction tender offer. Unifi said it was still determining the final purchase price for the shares but it would be in the range of $28 to $31 per share.
The company said it expected to purchase all shares tendered. The number of shares tendered included 415,634 shares tendered pursuant to guaranteed delivery, it said.
The Dutch auction expired on December 13.
After purchasing the tendered shares, Unifi said it would have about 62.8 million shares of common stock outstanding.
The Dutch auction offer had been announced on October 30. Unifi said then it inteneded to buy up to six million shares at a price range of $28 to $31 per share.
